bib.title: Alias-Free Generative Adversarial Networks
bib.venue: 35th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2021)

question: Why do GAN generators let fine detail stick to pixel coordinates, and can small architectural changes based on a continuous signal view remove it?
hypothesis: Aliasing from non-ideal upsampling filters and pointwise nonlinearities leaks absolute position into the hierarchy; suppressing it forces natural hierarchical synthesis with translation (and rotation) equivariance.
contributions: Identification of aliasing (non-ideal upsampling filters, pointwise nonlinearities) as root cause of texture sticking
Continuous-signal interpretation of layers and filtered nonlinearities
StyleGAN3-T and StyleGAN3-R generators matching StyleGAN2 FID with translation / rotation equivariance
EQ-T and EQ-R equivariance metrics (PSNR in dB)
Custom CUDA kernel for fused upsample-nonlinearity-downsample
New datasets: FFHQ-U, MetFaces-U, AFHQv2, Beaches

method.summary: The StyleGAN2 generator is rebuilt step by step (configs A to R): Fourier-feature input, no noise inputs, simplified mapping/normalisation, 10-pixel margins, Kaiser windowed-sinc 2x filters (n=6), leaky ReLU wrapped between 2x up and down sampling, non-critical sampling, per-layer flexible filter specs (N=14), and for StyleGAN3-R 1x1 convs plus radially symmetric jinc downsampling filters. The discriminator is unchanged. Evaluated with FID and new EQ-T/EQ-R PSNR metrics.

datasets.name: FFHQ / FFHQ-U
datasets.split: all images used for training; FID vs all training images
datasets.source: FFHQ CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; FFHQ-U rebuilt unaligned (axis-aligned crop, random offset normal with std 20% of crop size)

datasets.name: MetFaces / MetFaces-U
datasets.split: transfer from FFHQ(-U) snapshot with lowest FID, 5M images

datasets.name: AFHQv2
datasets.split: all three classes as one dataset, from scratch
datasets.source: AFHQ (CC BY-NC 4.0) rebuilt with PIL Lanczos resampling; ~2% images dropped

training.objective: non-saturating logistic loss with R1 regularization (lazy)
training.regularisation: R1 gamma per dataset (e.g. FFHQ 1024 T/R 32.8; FFHQ-U 256 gamma=1); ADA for small datasets; no path length or mixing reg in T/R; D blur sigma=10 px ramped to 0 over first 200k images in config R
training.hardware: NVIDIA DGX-1, 8 Tesla V100 GPUs, PyTorch 1.7.1, CUDA 11.0, cuDNN 8.0.5
training.compute: 92 GPU years (V100), 225 MWh whole project; Table 17 total 1876 runs

other.images_seen: 25M real images from scratch, 5M with transfer

inference.samples: FID: 50k generated images; EQ metrics: 50000 random (w,x) samples

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: between 50k generated images and all training images, official Inception network

metrics.name: EQ-T
metrics.definition: PSNR between generator output translated by integer offset x and output from translated input Fourier features; offsets U[-sN/8, sN/8]; Imax=2

metrics.name: EQ-R
metrics.definition: PSNR between rotated reference output and output from rotated input features, angle U(0,360 deg), with pseudo-rotation bandlimiting

metrics.name: EQ-Tfrac
metrics.definition: as EQ-T with fractional offsets and Lanczos (a=3) resampling

eval.protocol: Single training run per configuration reported (no seeds or variance stated); best-FID snapshot; R1 gamma grid-searched per dataset.

limits: Only the generator is made equivariant; the authors suspect the non-equivariant discriminator causes e.g. teeth not moving correctly
Assumes training data is not aliased; jagged, point-sampled, letterboxed or JPEG-heavy data conflicts with the design
Noise inputs removed; Beaches shows a reduced set of scene layouts, possibly from this
Path length regularization conflicts with equivariance
Operates in sRGB after tone mapping, not linear
Attention/tokenizing transformer GANs (VQGAN) not handled; open question
Equivariance beyond about 40-50 dB not measurable because subpixel resampling is ambiguous
FID slightly worse than StyleGAN2 on aligned FFHQ (2.79/3.07 vs 2.70); no seeds/variance reported
Video claims rest on hand-picked seeds in accompanying videos
Dated: GANs superseded by diffusion for text-to-image

terms.definition: fine detail appears fixed in pixel coordinates instead of moving with the depicted surface during latent interpolation
equivariance metrics: PSNR in dB between translated/rotated outputs and outputs from translated/rotated input
